CLAUDE.md — cfbfastR

Source: CLAUDE.md

cfbfastR is the R package for clean, tidy college-football play-by-play, schedule, roster, ratings, betting, recruiting, and box-score data. It wraps CollegeFootballData (CFBD), ESPN college-football endpoints, plus Fox Sports and Yahoo. Companions: sportsdataverse/cfbfastR-py (Python CFB surface), and the cfbfastR-cfb-raw (scraper) + cfbfastR-cfb-data (modeling/release) pipeline repos. Released on CRAN + r-universe. Docs: https://cfbfastR.sportsdataverse.org.

  • Version: 3.0.0 (DESCRIPTION) · License: MIT · R: >= 4.1.0 (native pipe |>)
  • Branch: main is default + release branch.
  • Maintainer: Saiem Gilani.

When this guide differs from the repo, treat CONTRIBUTING.md and the current tests/testthat/ suite as authoritative.

Commands

devtools::document()                                   # roxygen2 docs + NAMESPACE (never hand-edit man/ or NAMESPACE)
devtools::test()                                       # full testthat suite
testthat::test_file("tests/testthat/test-cfbd_games.R")# one file
devtools::check()                                      # R CMD check
devtools::install()                                    # local install
pkgdown::build_site()                                  # build docs site locally
devtools::build_readme()                               # re-render README.md from README.Rmd (never hand-edit README.md)

CI (.github/workflows/): R-CMD-check.yaml (windows + ubuntu release/oldrel-1, weekly cron, sets CFBD_API_KEY secret), pkgdown.yaml (push to main + release), rhub.yaml (manual dispatch). Markdown TOCs are regenerated by Rscript tools/run_doctoc.R --maxlevel 2 NEWS.md CLAUDE.md ... (no-Node doctoc replacement, idempotent). After DESCRIPTION edits run usethis::use_tidy_description().

Architecture (data sources + function families)

Five source-prefixed families; R/ is grouped by prefix:

Prefix Source Auth Notes
cfbd_* collegefootballdata.com CFBD_API_KEY bearer token games/plays/drives/teams/players/stats/ratings/recruiting/draft/betting/venues/coaches/conferences/metrics
espn_cfb_* / espn_metrics_* / espn_ratings_* ESPN (site.api.espn.com + sports.core.api.espn.com) none ~75 wrappers (3.0.0 expanded ESPN from 8 → 73); core-v2 $ref-heavy payloads
fox_cfb_* api.foxsports.com/bifrost/v1/cfb public web key 8 wrappers (pbp/boxscore/odds/roster/stats/gamelog/standings/leaders); key overridable via options(cfbfastR.fox_key=)
yahoo_cfb_* Yahoo Sports none scoreboard/boxscore/player+team season stats
load_cfb_* / load_espn_cfb_* / load_ncaa_mfb_* release artifacts none 43 full-season loaders from sportsdataverse-data releases

CFBD API key: register_cfbd() saves CFBD_API_KEY; cfbd_key() / has_cfbd_key() / cfbd_api_key_info() inspect it. Register at https://collegefootballdata.com/key.

Loaders: load_cfb_pbp(seasons) pulls per-season .rds from the sportsdataverse-data release tag cfbfastR_cfb_pbp (floor 2014, default most_recent_cfb_season()); load_cfb.R has load_cfb_rosters/_schedules/_teams. update_cfb_db() builds/refreshes a local SQLite copy. Progress via progressr (optional Suggest) — there is no furrr/future parallelism.

Release-dataset loaders (3.0.0): three generated-then-hand-maintained files follow the wehoop load_ncaa_wbb.R shape (seasons vector or TRUE, progressr, rbindlist, dbConnection/tablename write-through with dots forwarded to dbWriteTable): R/load_espn_cfb.R (27 load_espn_cfb_* ESPN-derived datasets, mostly 2004+), R/load_cfb_datasets.R (11 ratings / talent / recruiting / crosswalk datasets), R/load_ncaa_mfb.R (10 stats.ncaa.org datasets, 2013+, incl. FCS). One loader per release tag; stem == asset file prefix. Parquet-only tags go through parquet_from_url() (utils.R, arrow is Suggests → guarded by rlang::check_installed). PBP delineation: load_cfb_pbp = classic cfbfastR EPA pbp (2014+); load_espn_cfb_pbp = ESPN-derived 469-col pbp (2004+); load_ncaa_mfb_pbp = native stats.ncaa.org parse; load_ncaa_mfb_pbp_cfbfastr = same plays on cfbfastR column conventions. When a new tag appears on sportsdataverse-data, add a loader to the matching file following the neighboring function’s shape.

Modular PBP/EPA/WPA engine (R/pbp_*.R, landed in 3.0.0): legacy entry points cfbd_pbp_data() + espn_cfb_pbp(epa_wpa=) and v2 orchestrators cfbd_pbp_data_v2() + espn_cfb_pbp_v2() both feed one shared .run_epa_wpa() engine (pbp_epa_wpa_engine.R). Flow: .cfbd_to_epa_input() / .espn_to_epa_input() adapters (pbp_adapters.R) → engine → play taxonomy centralized in pbp_taxonomy.R (single source of truth, replaced 4 drifted copies) → .pbp_apply_output_schema(df, output=) applies .pbp_output_order column order + the "default"/"lean"/"full" tier selectors (pbp_output_schema.R). Models are mgcv/nnet/xgboost EP/FG/WP. ESPN team/venue/coach metadata the bare payload omits is resolved by .espn_pbp_game_meta().

Conventions

  • Native pipe |> only — %>%/magrittr swept out; not in Imports. |> rejects [[ as RHS (use purrr::pluck()) and has no . placeholder (use _ or \(x)).
  • Initialize every tryCatch return variable BEFORE the block (e.g. plays_df <- data.frame()). On API error the handler runs, the var never binds, and return(var) throws object not found instead of the intended cli_alert_danger() + empty fallback. Applies to all return names; init list()/NULL/data.frame() as appropriate.
  • Scalar-default args, not c(...) + match.arg(). Default output = "default", document choices in @param, validate with cli::cli_abort(). The c-vector form silently picks the first element on a vector arg.
  • cli for all messaging: cli_alert_danger/warning/info/success inside handlers; cli_abort/cli_warn for raised conditions. Pass {conditionMessage(e)}, never raw {e} (glue coerces the condition).
  • Pipeline tail: ... |> janitor::clean_names() |> make_cfbfastR_data("<desc>", Sys.time()) sets class c("cfbfastR_data","tbl_df","tbl","data.table","data.frame") + timestamp/type attrs. Apply it after the final dplyr verb (dplyr strips the class).
  • Column-drift resilience: drop with dplyr::select(-dplyr::any_of("col")), rename with rename(any_of(c(new = "old"))) — both APIs add/rename columns over time.
  • Null safety: %||% (re-exported from rlang via @importFrom; don’t redefine).
  • ESPN self-describing returns: catalog wrappers call .attach_query_meta_auto() (utils_attach_query_meta.R), which introspects caller formals and lifts query args (season/week/team_id/…) onto the frame as leading columns (year→season); add a conventionally-named arg and it auto-flows. Response columns win on name collision.
  • Proxy: get_req() resolves proxy= arg → getOption("cfbfastR.proxy") → http(s)_proxy env. Thread proxy = NULL/... through new wrappers for per-call override.

Caching

ESPN catalog calls are memoised (cachem + memoise, wired in zzz.R .onLoad): options(cfbfastR.cache = "memory"|"filesystem"|"off") (default memory), options(cfbfastR.cache_duration = 86400) (TTL seconds). espn_cfb_clear_cache() forgets all cached endpoints; filesystem backend persists under tools::R_user_dir("cfbfastR","cache"). CFBD endpoints are NOT cached (pagination/date variation would return wrong rows).

Testing

  • Tests gate network calls with skip_on_cran() + skip_on_ci() (and a few skip_if()). setup-cfbd-throttle.R hot-swaps get_req() to Sys.sleep() between CFBD calls (avoids 429 storms); tune with options(cfbfastR.test_request_delay=). Config/testthat/edition: 3.
  • Column assertions use the subset direction: expect_in(sort(expected), sort(colnames(x))) (expected ⊆ actual) so a new upstream column doesn’t fail the run. Add a skip-if-empty guard right after every API call (if (nrow(x)==0) skip(...)) for transient 500s/429s.
  • test-pbp_equivalence.R asserts v2 reproduces legacy cfbd_pbp_data()/espn_cfb_pbp() column-for-column, with an explicit allow-list of intentional deltas (character id_play, logical scoring_play, total-seconds clock_seconds, short-name *_player_name). Any other diff is a regression. Tier-monotonicity tests verify lean ⊆ default ⊆ full.

Gotchas

  • refactor/pbp-epa-wpa-modular is merged — the modular engine + ESPN catalog expansion shipped in 3.0.0 on main. Don’t look for a separate dev branch.
  • CFBD rate limits: free tier caps per-minute; wrappers surface cli_alert_danger on 429 but don’t hot-retry — Sys.sleep() and re-run the range.
  • ESPN $ref payloads: core API returns {"$ref": "..."} placeholders instead of inlined team/athlete/venue records. Route team-metadata consumers through .espn_pbp_game_meta() (falls back to cached .espn_cfb_team_lookup()), not raw field reads.
  • season convention: calendar year of the fall season (Jan-2024 Rose Bowl is season=2023); OT possessions model as drives with period >= 5.
  • Functions deprecated via lifecycle::deprecate_stop() + @keywords internal live in cfbd_metrics.R / espn_cfb_ratings.R and are excluded from the pkgdown index.
  • _pkgdown.yml auto-picks starts_with("cfbd_"/"espn_cfb_"/"load_cfb_"); other new exports need a manual reference: entry. Keep NEWS.md / cran-comments.md / _pkgdown.yml in sync on any API-surface change. New NEWS.md bullets go under the current # **cfbfastR v3.0.0** heading — don’t open a new version section before release.
  • Never hand-edit NAMESPACE or man/ — regenerate with devtools::document().
  • Never add AI co-author trailers (Claude/Copilot/etc.) to commits. Conventional Commits (feat:/fix:/docs:/test:/refactor:/chore:/ci:), scope when useful (fix(pbp): ...). ```
